candidates.change_summary: Delete the owner check, allowing anyone to call sendTo.
Delete the zero-address check, allowing transfers to address(0) which burn funds instead of reverting.
Delete the positive amount check, allowing zero-amount transfers that change the receiver's ETH balance without transferring value, observable via event or external call reentrancy/gas differences.
Replace transfer with send, changing the success/failure behavior (no revert on failure) and affecting ETH balance of receiver.
Replace transfer with call, changing success behavior and enabling gas forwarding/reentrancy, observably different when receiver runs out of gas or has fallback logic.
Replace the owner check with an incorrect condition (e.g., msg.sender != owner), making only non-owners able to call.
Change the amount requirement to a different threshold, e.g., amount >= 1 ether, altering which calls succeed.
Insert a selfdestruct to the owner after transfer, permanently changing the contract's behavior on subsequent calls.
Replace the receiver address with msg.sender, so ETH is always sent back to the caller, observable by ETH balance change.
Replace the receiver address with owner, so ETH is always sent to the owner, observable by ETH balance change.
